title: Affine upper-tail chart comparisons
statement: For any preorder I, ring diagram R, spectrum cone c, fixed i, morphism Xi -> Spec(R_i) and chart V.X a, use the actual upperTailChartDiagram and upperTailChartCone constructed by slice pullback along V.f a followed by f (new-affine-chart-upper-tail-limit-data). Pullback pasting gives an isomorphism z of its vertex with the limit chart Z, stage isomorphisms e, and iterated-chart isomorphisms h, satisfying the two equations of new-affine-chart-upper-tail-limit. This concerns this specified cone, not arbitrary affine limiting diagrams, and needs neither directedness nor a limit hypothesis.

proof.text: Use pullbackSymmetry, inverse pullbackRightPullbackFstIso, and pullbackSymmetry again to construct z and every e for the explicitly defined diagram and cone. This uses only the definitions in the data node, not its limiting theorem.

For the baseChangeMap p, pullback.map gives p followed by the stage first projection equal to the limit first projection. Construct h by pullbackRightPullbackFstIso followed by pullback.congrHom for this equality. Its first equation is the first-projection identity. To prove the second, apply pullback.hom_ext to the stage chart and then to its ambient base change. The projection formulas for the three isomorphisms and Over.pullback reduce all components to pullback.condition and the two projection identities of baseChangeMap. All equations are proved by these identities.

proof_origin.place: R3 second reading: canonical pullback-pasting isomorphisms and projection identities; fully proved.

lean.statement: theorem affine_chart_upper_tail_limit_comparisons {I : Type u} [Preorder I] (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) (c : Cone (R.op ⋙ Scheme.Spec)) (i : I) {Xi : Scheme.{u}} (f : Xi ⟶ Spec (R.obj i)) (V : Xi.OpenCover.{u}) (a : V.I₀) : let D := upperTailChartDiagram R i (V.f a ≫ f) let d := upperTailChartCone R c i (V.f a ≫ f) let W := V.pullback₁ (pullback.fst f (c.π.app (op i))) let Z := W.X a ∃ z : d.pt ≅ Z, ∀ j : {j : I // i ≤ j}, let U : (pullback f (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE j.property)))).OpenCover.{u} := V.pullback₁ (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE j.property)))) let p := baseChangeMap f (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE j.property)))) (T' := Over.mk (c.π.app (op i))) (Over.homMk (c.π.app (op j.val)) (c.w (homOfLE j.property).op)) let Y := (U.pullback₁ p).X a ∃ (e : D.obj (op j) ≅ U.X a) (h : Y ≅ Z), h.hom ≫ W.f a = (U.pullback₁ p).f a ∧ h.hom ≫ z.inv ≫ d.π.app (op j) ≫ e.hom = U.pullbackHom p a
